description: Curated copy of paper-facing results. Originals remain under outputs/; nothing was moved or deleted. Raw NetCDF trajectories, restart checkpoints and downloaded source archives are intentionally excluded.

01-mola-topography-comparisons.paper_use: Topography and MOLA/Ames/MCD/ARCO cross-reference figures. Not observational validation.

02-ablations.paper_use: Physics sensitivity, timestep and one-year stability evidence. RMSE is relative to each run's full case, not independent truth.

03-benchmarks.paper_use: Benchmark, performance and reproducibility tables. Model/reference comparisons are diagnostics, not observational truth.

04-neural-experiments.paper_use: Framework neural-capability demonstrations on generated data. No Mars forecast skill established.
